code:
import mlflow

with mlflow.start_run():
    mlflow.log_param("learning_rate", 0.001)
    mlflow.log_param("batch_size", 64)
    mlflow.log_metric("val_accuracy", 0.942)
    mlflow.log_artifact("model.pt")
caption: Every parameter and metric becomes permanently queryable — a real comparison, not a memory.

code:
from mlflow import MlflowClient

client = MlflowClient()
client.transition_model_version_stage(
    name="fraud-model",
    version=3,
    stage="Production",
)

# Stages: None -> Staging -> Production -> Archived
caption: Promotion is a deliberate, logged action — rollback just points Production at the last version.
